integrity: The constants and limits are derived in the proof; finite numerical checks are supplementary. Existing algorithmic identities and earlier noisy-Anderson convergence studies are credited. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: One scalar depth-one update, affine strict contractions, independent additive Gaussian oracle errors, exact arithmetic; no multi-step convergence, higher-dimensional, bounded-noise, or adaptive-regularization claims. Potential bibliographic overlap with unavailable full 2017 inaccurate-evaluation research.
title: Pareto-one tails and singular ridge risk of Gaussian-noisy scalar Anderson acceleration
